theorem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.anchors_gcd :
  forall {c q a₀ : Nat} {A : Finset Nat},
  Dvd.dvd q c → Membership.mem A a₀ → Eq (Finset.gcd (Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.anchors c q a₀ A) id)
    (Finset.gcd (Insert.insert q A) id) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.menu_card (q k : Nat) (A : Finset Nat) (qp : LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) q)
  (res : (forall (a : Nat), Membership.mem A a → LT.lt a q)) :
  Eq (Finset.card (Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.menu (HMul.hMul k q) q A)) (HMul.hMul k (Finset.card A)) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.four_residues :
  And (Eq (Finset.gcd (Insert.insert (OfNat.ofNat 210) Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.residues210) id) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
    (forall (x : Nat),
    Membership.mem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.residues210 x → (forall (y : Nat)
      (a._@._internal._hyg.0 : Membership.mem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.residues210 y) (z : Nat),
    Membership.mem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.residues210 z → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1)
      (Nat.gcd (OfNat.ofNat 210) (Nat.gcd x (Nat.gcd y z))))) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.every_three_share_prime (x y z : Nat)
  (hx : Membership.mem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.residues210 (HMod.hMod x (OfNat.ofNat 210)))
  (hy : Membership.mem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.residues210 (HMod.hMod y (OfNat.ofNat 210)))
  (hz : Membership.mem Shellsort.PeriodicMenus.residues210 (HMod.hMod z (OfNat.ofNat 210))) :
  Exists
    (fun (p : Nat) =>
    And (Nat.Prime p) (And (Dvd.dvd p (OfNat.ofNat 210)) (And (Dvd.dvd p x) (And (Dvd.dvd p y) (Dvd.dvd p z))))) :=
  _

axiom propext {a b : Sort 0} : Iff a b → Eq a b

axiom Quot.sound.{u} {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Sort 0} {a b : α} : r a b → Eq (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk r b)

axiom Classical.choice.{u} {α : Sort u} : Nonempty α → α
